Founder & solo developer / 2026–present

Readerfold

An AI manuscript-feedback platform for fiction writers. Each simulated reader carries impressions and open questions across sections, giving the author different perspectives on the same story.

50+ users acquired organically.

  • Built the complete stack solo with React, FastAPI, Supabase, and LiteLLM.
  • Designed a multi-model LLM pipeline with persona prompting, JSON validation and repair, usage tracking, and credit controls.
  • Built freemium pricing that scales with manuscript length and panel size.
  • Handle support and turn recurring customer feedback into product changes.
